about: What things are. A class says how a thing is held and picks the runtime; a type says what it is and picks the material. Built-in entries live here; types and examples taught with types.teach() go to the user registry (~/.claude/follow-through/types.json), which is read on top of this file. Materials carry their derivation in `source`.

gelatin.source: Gelatin gel shear modulus G' 2-10 kPa; for a nearly incompressible block f ~ c_s/(4H) with c_s = sqrt(G/rho): an 8 cm cube at 2 kPa wobbles at 4.4 Hz. Real loss factor gives damping ~0.02; 0.08 lets it settle in a few seconds.

custard.source: Softer set than gelatin (1.5-3 Hz), heavier damping, and dents that stay once pressed past 10% strain. Design values, unmeasured.

slime.source: Flows by creep rather than by softness: almost any strain creeps into the rest shape. At 1 Hz its sag under gravity (g / w^2 = 25 cm) was larger than the 28 cm blob itself and the lattice folded flat to 4% of its volume, so the elastic part is 2.5 Hz and near critically damped. Not sticky here - pinned to what it lands on, it could never flow off it; high friction holds it instead. Design values.

clay.source: Stiff elastic response (8-15 Hz), critically damped, and plastic past 2-5% strain with creep 5-20 /s (Mueller et al. 2005 sec. 4.5 model; ranges from the FleX plastic scenes and Houdini Vellum plasticity). 8 Hz rather than 15 keeps substeps affordable.

water_balloon.source: Fluid mass in a membrane: 2-4 Hz, damped 0.25 by the water sloshing inside (0.1-0.2 is the membrane alone), and squashes while keeping its volume (squash 0.8 - at 1 every volume-preserving shear is free, nothing pulls it back, and the verifier measured no wobble at all). Friction 0.7, the rubber skin gripping: at 0.4 the round balloon crept on a flat floor at 0.29 m/s. Godot's SoftBody3D pressure would inflate a surface, but Jolt builds no bend or volume constraints in 4.7.2, so shape matching carries it.

rigid.source: Nothing moves: a rock measures like a jello and is recognised by look or name.

soft_fat.source: Breast adipose Young's modulus 3.25 +- 0.91 kPa (Samani et al. 2007), density ~950 kg/m3: G = E/3, c_s ~ 1.07 m/s, f ~ c_s/(4R) ~ 2.7 Hz for R = 0.1 m before skin and ligament stiffen it. Damping ratio 0.2-0.35 is the usual game choice (visible wobble that settles).

firm_flesh.source: Muscle and tighter tissue (thighs, calves, cheeks): 5-10 Hz, heavily damped. Soft tissue after impacts rings in the 10-40 Hz band, higher when the muscle is active.

bloated.source: A gas- and fluid-filled corpse torso: low (1.5-3 Hz), lightly damped, heavy, sloshing more than swinging. Design values.

hair.source: Hair has almost no bending stiffness at the scale of a ponytail: what brings it back is gravity. Each bone springs at the frequency of the hair hanging below its root as a compound pendulum, f = (1/2pi) sqrt(3g/2h): a 37 cm ponytail's root bone 1.0 Hz, its last 7 cm 2.3 Hz. Keratin density ~1300 kg/m3. Damping 0.5 was set on Godot's verify_strands.gd: at 0.3 a ponytail on the MPFB woman was still swinging 4.9 deg four seconds after a 1.5 m/s knock and reached 94 deg of tip swing on her run; at 0.5 it settles to a tenth in 2.4 s (the sample figure 1.9 s) and swings 45 deg at most (the figure 14). The angle limits are design values. collision_friction 0.1 (of the sliding speed per 1/120 s in contact), also set on the verifier: without it a ponytail resting on the sample figure's neck gained swing on every stride of a run (tip 22 to 95 deg at damping 0.3); with it the swing holds steady.

jello.description: set gelatin: holds its shape and wobbles; sticks to the plate it was turned out on

slime.description: barely holds a shape and flows under gravity

clay_ball.description: stiff but plastic: flattens where it lands and rolls into a pebble

water_balloon.description: a skin full of water: sags, sloshes, keeps its volume

breast.limit_note: max_offset_m = limit_share x peak_m. Nothing but this limit keeps flesh from swinging into the body, and a breast swung in further than it stands out passes its skin into the chest: two thirds of its stand-out (Belle: 8.2 cm of 12.4 cm).
breast.description: a breast or pectoral fat pad: pivots from the chest wall, swings and bounces

belly.limit_note: limit_max_share x peak_m is the most flesh.suggest_limits may raise max_offset_m to: the jiggle bone's tip moves by the whole offset, so a mass carried further than it stands out of the lean body puts its skin inside it. 1.0: behind a belly is the abdominal wall, so its own stand-out is the whole of the travel it has. No measured share is worth more than that; the shipped limit is the material's 1.2 x peak_m, which a suggestion tightens.
belly.description: abdominal fat in front of the spine: moves as a mass, bounces on each step

bloater_belly.limit_note: limit_max_share x peak_m is the most flesh.suggest_limits may raise max_offset_m to: the jiggle bone's tip moves by the whole offset, so a mass carried further than it stands out of the lean body puts its skin inside it. 1.0, a belly's: swollen or not, what is behind it is the torso. The sample Bloater stands 22 cm out and sloshes; a limit past that would let a quarter of a metre of belly through its own spine.
bloater_belly.description: a swollen torso: named so, or a belly standing out by at least 20% of the body's volume and 8% of its height (the test figure's belly: 16.5% and 6.3%; the bloater's: 23% and 9.4%), slow and sloshing

butt.limit_note: max_offset_m = limit_share x peak_m, and limit_max_share bounds what flesh.suggest_limits may raise it to. The swing was set on Godot's jiggle self-test on Belle while rings read her seat at 3.7 cm: 5.8 cm sat on the limit 11-12% of the time running, crouch walking and landing, 6.9 cm (1.9 x 3.7) 8-9%, under the 10% the self-test allows. Read from the side (improvements 05 5.9) her buttocks stand 7.8 cm out, and 0.9 keeps that swing (7.0 cm) - about the depth of a full buttock's fat pad. That depth is also the cap: a buttock swung further than its own pad is thick carries its skin into the pelvis.
butt.description: a buttock: behind the hips, bounces on every footfall; rides the pelvis, not the thigh

love_handle.limit_note: limit_max_share x peak_m is the most flesh.suggest_limits may raise max_offset_m to: the jiggle bone's tip moves by the whole offset, so a mass carried further than it stands out of the lean body puts its skin inside it. 1.0: a love handle sits on the iliac crest, so the hip bone is a hand's breadth behind its surface and its own stand-out is all the travel it has.
love_handle.description: fat over the hip at the side of the waist

thigh.limit_note: limit_max_share x peak_m is the most flesh.suggest_limits may raise max_offset_m to: the jiggle bone's tip moves by the whole offset, so a mass carried further than it stands out of the lean body puts its skin inside it. 1.0: thigh flesh wraps the femur, and its stand-out is measured over the lean leg. Firm flesh swings little; a limit past its stand-out would only let a shudder cut into the leg.
thigh.description: thigh flesh: a firm, damped shudder on impact

arm_flab.limit_note: limit_max_share x peak_m is the most flesh.suggest_limits may raise max_offset_m to: the jiggle bone's tip moves by the whole offset, so a mass carried further than it stands out of the lean body puts its skin inside it. 1.0: flab hangs under the triceps, with the humerus right behind it. The Figure's flab stands 2.2 cm out, and a suggester with no cap raised it to 5.7 cm at response 1.0 and 6.7 cm at 1.5 - three times through its own arm.
arm_flab.description: loose flesh under the upper arm

ponytail.description: hair gathered at one point of the head and hanging from it: swings on every step

long_hair.description: a lock of loose long hair: one chain per lock, hanging from the head
